svg.text: “I replace hours of work with scripts. Then pretend it was team effort ;)”
by DJ Thirty Seconds ft. Chai
EEE engineer @ Indo Tech Transformers (Kanchipuram!!). I test transformers
& then write the software the whole plant runs on. 9 apps in production,
128 tests, 1 patent filed (street lights that FOLLOW YOUR CAR omg).
Ranked #7 out of 1500+ colleges @ IIT Bombay NEC. no big deal. ok it's a big deal.
Who I'd like to meet: anyone with a spreadsheet they hate.
“we're out again. you used all of us on the dispatch release.”
“started on the railways. told you it would work out.”
